title: Act: Add execution action handlers to AdminApp
summary: runExecutionAction calls the client function, reloads and is passed to ExecutionPanel
description: Import approveExecution, retryExecution, rejectExecution in AdminApp.tsx. Add a runExecutionAction helper modelled on runRoundAction, and pass onApprove, onRetry and onReject to ExecutionPanel.
acceptance_criteria: ExecutionPanel receives onApprove, onRetry and onReject from AdminApp
Each handler awaits the client call and then increments reloads
definition_of_done: npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend

steps.action: Add approveExecution, rejectExecution and retryExecution to the value imports from '../api/client' in alphabetical position.
steps.code: import { ApiError, approveExecution, closeRound, ..., openRound, rejectExecution, retryExecution, WORLD_ID, ... }
steps.expected: The three client functions are importable in AdminApp.tsx

steps.lines: after L17 (type) and after runRoundAction L90-L98
steps.action: Add type ExecutionAction = (token: string, id: string) => Promise<ExecutionInfo>. Inside AdminApp, after runRoundAction, add async function runExecutionAction(action: ExecutionAction, id: string) that awaits action(token, id) in try and then calls setReloads((n) => n + 1); in catch it calls handleError(err).
steps.expected: Calling it posts to the endpoint and triggers a reload

steps.action: Pass onApprove={(id) => runExecutionAction(approveExecution, id)}, onRetry={(id) => runExecutionAction(retryExecution, id)} and onReject={(id) => runExecutionAction(rejectExecution, id)} to ExecutionPanel.
steps.expected: Approve/Reject buttons render for AWAITING_APPROVAL and Retry for FAILED
